title: Vegan Pumpkin Dip
summary: Pumpkin puree, coconut cream, and maple syrup make this vegan pumpkin dip taste just like a spoonful of pumpkin pie filling! I whip everything together with pumpkin pie spice for a creamy and lightly …
ingredients: 14 oz coconut milk (remove cream from the top of the can)
steps: Skim the coconut cream off the top of the can. Dispose of the water that has fallen to the bottom.
Combine coconut cream, pumpkin puree, maple syrup, and pumpkin pie spice in a mixing bowl. Stir to combine.
Use a hand mixer to whip the ingredients together until they create a light and fluffy texture, about 1-2 minutes. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to an hour. Dip will thicken as it cools.
author: Anjali Shah
